artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth Enthroned
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of Queen Elizabeth I of England sitting on a throne. She is depicted from head to toe, facing forward with a composed expression. Her hair is styled elaborately, wearing a crown. Queen Elizabeth is dressed in a gown and a robe lined with ermine. She holds a scepter in her right hand and a globe with a cross in her left hand. The background features a tapestry, a royal coat of arms, and draped curtains on the sides.

artworks.title: Lady Jane Grey
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman shown from the waist up. She is facing forward with her body slightly turned to her right. She has a composed expression with a slight smile, neatly styled hair, and a decorative headpiece adorned with pearls. She is wearing a high-collared dress with intricate embroidery, lace, jewel patterns, and a necklace. She holds a small, closed book in her right hand, and wears rings on her fingers. The background is an ornate oval frame with Latin script, ribbons, and a coat of arms. The overall aesthetic is formal and historical.

artworks.title: George Herbert, Prebendary of Lincoln, Poet
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person's upper body in a three-quarter view, facing right. The person has a slender face with sharp features, including a slightly protruding chin and a long nose. Their shoulder-length, wavy hair, appears light with a center part and is covered by a black cap. The person is wearing a dark, ornate robe with a wide, white collar. The background consists of an intricately detailed oval with a textured pattern. Under the portrait is a decorative rectangle with text identifying the subject as Mr. George Herbert, the author of "The Temple."

artworks.title: Denzil, First Baron Holles
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man facing slightly to his left. He has distinct facial features with curly hair extending to his shoulders and is dressed in formal attire. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with foliage patterns, a coat of arms, and an inscription identifying him as "The Right Honble Denzel Baron Holles of Ifield." The background has a hatched texture.

artworks.title: William Laud, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.artist: Robert White after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body facing to his right, with defined facial features, a moustache, and a pointed beard. He wears ecclesiastical attire including a large soft cap, a ruff, a robe, and a bishop's gown with voluminous sleeves. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background features an oval frame with a coat of arms below it. The lower part shows an ornate script with his identity and title.

artworks.title: Sir John Marsham, Writer on Chronology
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing slightly to the left. He has a somber expression, long wavy hair, a mustache, and a beard. He is wearing a cap, a dark robe, and a white collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with floral and ribbon decorations. Under the frame, there is a cartouche with a shield and a Latin inscription with the subject's name, "Johannes Marsham Eques Auratus & Baronetus," and his age. The background consists of engraved lines for texture.

artworks.title: John Overall, D.D., Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's bust, positioned centrally within an ornate oval frame. The man sits upright with a composed expression. He has a short beard and mustache, short dark hair covered with a cap, and wears a ruffled collar, cloak, and a decorative garment. The oval frame is adorned with baroque elements. Below the portrait, there are Latin inscriptions and a heraldic emblem with a crossed design and mitres. The background is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: John Overall
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing the viewer with a slightly angled body to the left. He has a composed expression, a pointed beard, and short, dark hair. The man is wearing a broad, ruffled collar and a robe or coat. Around him is an ornate oval frame with classical leaf motifs. Beneath the portrait is a decorative crest featuring three mitres, a cross, and some Latin script. The background has a textured pattern of fine lines.

artworks.title: Samuel Pepys, Secretary to the Admiralty, Diarist
artworks.artist: Robert White after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is an intricately detailed engraving showing an upper-body portrait of a man in a three-quarter view. His facial features include a wide forehead, arched eyebrows, large eyes, a prominent nose, and full lips. The man has long, curly hair cascading down past his shoulders. He is wearing elaborate clothing with rich embroidery or lace at the neck. The portrait is framed within an ornate oval border. The background has fine lines that contrast with the oval frame, and a ribbon banner below the oval displays Latin text.

artworks.title: William Petyt, Keeper of the Records in the Tower
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man. The man is shown facing slightly to his left in a formal pose. He has curly hair, arched eyebrows, a long nose, and a serious expression. He is dressed in a dark coat with a wide collar and a white cravat at the neck. The background features an oval frame with decorations, a coat of arms, and an inscription with the man's name and titles. The style is typical of formal engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Henry Purcell, Musical Composer
artworks.artist: Robert White after Johann Baptist Closterman
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with long curly hair, wearing historical clothing. The man is facing forward with a slightly turned body to the left. Surrounding the man is an ornate oval frame with ribbons, a coat of arms, and the name "Henricus Purcell" engraved below it. The background features classical portrait engraving elements.

artworks.title: William Sancroft, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man within an oval decorative border. The man is seated, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has defined facial features, a cap covering his head, and is wearing traditional clerical attire. Surrounding him is an ornate oval frame with decorative elements, including a coat of arms. Vertical lines in the background create a textured effect.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right while looking at the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair covering his ears and extending past his collar, along with a straight fringe above his eyes. His facial features include a prominent nose, a subtle smile, and elongated eyes. He wears a high-collared shirt and a dark cloak with buttons or embellishments along the edge. There are no visible objects or jewelry on him. The portrait is framed in an oval with floral motifs at the top and draped curtains on the sides, suggesting a classical or formal style. Below the oval is the inscription "JOHANNES SELDENUS Armig." The background features intricate line patterns for texture.

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: This image is a portrait featuring the upper half of a man's body within an oval frame. The man faces slightly to the right but looks directly at the viewer. He has pronounced facial features, including a long nose and prominent eyebrows. His medium-length, wavy hair is parted in the middle, reaching below his shoulders. He wears dark clothing with a high collar and visible buttons. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features intricate line work resembling a textured fabric pattern. Decorative elements surround the oval frame, and below the portrait, the name "JOHANNES SELDENUS, Armig." is inscribed in elegant script.

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, and a serious expression. They are dressed formally with a cloak over the shoulders and a wide collar visible. The portrait is in an oval frame with a decorative inscription panel below bearing the name "Johannes Selden." The background within the oval is dark and textured. The framing is detailed, possibly imitating classical elements. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's bust-length portrait, facing the viewer with a slight turn of the shoulders. The man has a high forehead, prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and long wavy hair styled with a middle parting falling to his shoulders. He wears a dark robe or cloak and a white collar is visible. An oval frame with intricate patterns surrounds him, with an emblem or coat of arms on the right. The background has a lined pattern text below the portrait, presenting formal information typical of period engravings.

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: This  is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a long, narrow face with prominent cheekbones, a long nose, and a thin-lipped mouth. The man's eyes are deeply set under heavy brows. His wavy hair falls just past his shoulders. He is wearing a high-collared garment with draped fabric. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features a textured, engraved oval border with an inscribed scroll below the oval, containing the text "JOANNES SELDENUS" followed by additional cursive script.

artworks.title: John Souter, Merchant at Exeter
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man named Mr. John Souter. He is shown from the upper half of his body, positioned slightly to the right with his head facing forward. The man has long, curly hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a slight smile. He is wearing formal attire from the 17th or 18th century, including a white cravat and a dark coat. The portrait is within an oval frame with a textured background, typical of engravings. A label below the portrait reads "Mr. John Souter."

artworks.title: John Whitgift, D.D., Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of an individual identified as Dr. John Whitgift. He is depicted from the chest up, facing forward inside an ornate oval frame. Dr. Whitgift has a prominent nose, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a dark cap, ruffled collar, dark robe, and an undergarment with a decorative neckline. The background consists of horizontal lines, and the frame includes scrollwork and a decorative cherub above the subject's head. Below the figure, a plaque identifies the individual as "The most Reverend Dr. John Whitgift Ld. Arch-Bishop of Canterbury" with a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Benjamin Woodroffe, R.R.S., Canon of Christ Church, Oxford
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He has shoulder-length grayish wavy hair and a high forehead. The man is wearing a dark robe with a white collar. The portrait is in an ornate oval frame with decorative scrollwork. Below the frame is a coat of arms with a crest featuring a horse-like figure and floral elements. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Title Page to The Life of Faith by Richard Baxter
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious theme illustrating "The Life of Faith." The image features an intricate diagram divided into three main sections marked "Fide," "Spe," and "Charitate," translating to "Faith," "Hope," and "Charity." The central focus is a large oval with the Latin words "DEO PATRI FILIO SPIR S." Flanking the oval are two figures, one carrying a child and the other holding a staff. A banner at the top reads "The Life of Faith Per Christum." The oval is segmented into sectors representing virtues necessary for a life of faith, with smaller figures and Latin inscriptions depicting their actions and virtues. Various religious symbols are present, and cloud patterns suggest a divine presence. The image appears designed for educational and religious purposes, balancing line, and text to convey a solemn message.

artworks.title: Title Page to Gilbert Burnet, Historie of theReformation of the Church of England
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the reformation of the Church of England. The image depicts an elaborate allegorical scene featuring architectural structures and symbolic actions against elements like "Superstition" and "Religion." Figures are engaged in activities on two sides; on one, individuals are dismantling or confronting structures labeled as "Superstition," while on the other, they appear to be building or maintaining a structure under the banner "Religion." The scene is set within an architectural framework with decorative columns and a grand arch adorned with a banner displaying the event's title. Symbols of authority and scripture are present, indicating a rich religious and political context.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Banck after Edward Lutterell
artworks.description: The image is a bust portrait of Queen Elizabeth. She is positioned facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. She has an elaborate hairstyle adorned with curls and wears a crown on top of her head. Her facial features include a composed expression with gentle eyes. Elizabeth is dressed in a richly decorated gown featuring a high lace collar, commonly known as a ruff, and a bodice adorned with intricate detailing and pearls. She is also wearing a pearl necklace and drop earrings. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame featuring ribbons and crown motifs, which is further surrounded by a decorative border with floral patterns and leaf designs. At the bottom of the frame, there is an inscribed plaque with the name "QUEEN ELIZABETH" and a coat of arms. The background is a detailed decorative engraving.

artworks.title: Roger Assham and Mary Surrounded by MedallianPortraits
artworks.description: The image features a central scene with two figures within an ornate architectural setting. The figures are shown within a historical setting and wear elaborate costumes characteristic of the Elizabethan era. The background includes architectural details and decorative stonework. Surrounding the central scene are portraits of historical figures with names inscribed below each.
